		{Expected Discharge Date} as string,

	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [FacilityID] AS \'Facility ID\',[FacilityName] AS \'Facility Name\',case when convert(varchar, [AdmitDate], 101)=\'01/01/1753\' then \'\' else convert(varchar, [AdmitDate], 101) END AS \'Admit Date\',[DischargeDate] AS \'Discharge Date\',[Member] AS \'Member ID (Facets)\',[Member Name] AS \'Member Name\',[Sex] AS \'Sex\',[DOB] AS \'DOB\',[AGE] AS \'AGE\',[Class] AS \'Class\',[PlanID] AS \'Plan ID\',[Ref Id] AS \'Ref ID\',[RoomType] AS \'Room Type\',[Admitting Diagnosis] AS \'Admitting Diagnosis\',[PriorAdmits] AS \'Prior Admits\',[Prior Date] AS \'Prior Description\',[SNF/LTC/SubAcuteFacility] AS \'SNF/LTC/SubAcute Facility\',[SNF/LTCSubAcuteRoom Type] AS \'SNF/LTC/SubAcute Room Type\',convert(varchar, [Room Type Start Date],101) AS \'Room Type Start Date\',convert(varchar, [Room Type End Date],101) AS \'Room Type End Date\',[Number of Days In Room Type] AS \'Number of Days In Room Type\',[HCIA LOS] AS \'HCIA LOS\',[12 mo LOS] AS \'12 mo LOS\',[Req LOS] AS \'Req LOS\',[Auth LOS] AS \'Auth LOS\',convert(varchar, [Next Review],101) AS \'Next Review Date\',convert(varchar, [Exp DC],101) AS \'Expected Discharge Date\',[Att Phys ID] AS \'Att Phys ID\',[Att Phys (Phone)] AS \'Att Phys Name (Phone)\',[PCP ID] AS \'PCP ID\',[PCP] AS \'PCP Name\',[Chronic Care Program] AS \'Chronic Care Program\',[Restricted Member Indicator] AS \'Restricted Member Indicator\',[Surgical Procedure] AS \'Surgical Procedure\',[Surgical Proc Date] AS \'Surgical Proc Date\',[COB TPL Ind] AS \'COB TPL Ind\',[Open CM Diag] AS \'Open CM Diag\',[CM Pri User] AS \'CM Pri User\',[RAS] AS \'RAS\',[DRG] AS \'DRG\',[Plan Risk Rank] AS \'Plan Risk Rank\',[CI3 Group (0-3)] AS \'CI3 Group(0-3)\',[Disease Cohort] AS \'Disease Cohort\',[COMORBIDITIES] AS \'Comorbidities\',[Comments] AS \'Comments\',[Rising Star] AS \'Rising Star\',[AUTHTYPE] AS \'Auth Type\',[CASESTATUS] AS \'Case Status\',[CASESTATUS_DESC] AS \'Case Status Desc\',[PCP_AFFILIATION] AS \'PCP Affiliation\',[MEPE_TERM_DT] AS \'Term Date\',convert(varchar,[FACETS_RUNTIME],121) AS \'FACETS Runtime\',[SVC_DENIAL_FLAG] AS \'Service Denial Flag\',[CurrentLOS] AS \'Current LOS\',[DRG_DESC] AS \'DRG DESC\',[ER_COUNT_12MOS] AS \'ER count 12mos\',[ReadmitFlag] AS \'Readmit Flag\',[PCP_COUNT_12MOS] AS \'PCP count 12mos\',[SPC_COUNT_12MOS] AS \'SPC count 12mos\', [Patient_Risk] AS \'Patient Risk\', [Source_System] AS \'Source System\',  [CASE_CREATED] AS \'Case Created\' , [CM_Pri_User_Name] as \'CM Pri User Name\' FROM UtilMgmtVW.DailyCensusBH WHERE (1=1) AND ReportName=\'Behavioral Health Hourly Report\' AND [GroupID] NOT IN ( \'INEGR002\', \'IN002GRS\') AND source_system <> \'ACMS\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceQuery

		AGE = toString(AGE)) ~> DataConversion00
